{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend blazer, tailored fit, knee-length, charcoal gray (#36454F), heavy wool blend.
Silk-blend blouse, relaxed collar, hip-length, ivory white (#FFFFF0), soft silk crepe de chine.
Wool-twill trousers, straight leg, ankle-length, deep slate blue (#2F4F4F), dense virgin wool.
Leather loafers, classic cap-toe design, mid-calf height, dark brown (#3B2F2F), full-grain calfskin.
Cashmere scarf, rectangular shape, loosely draped, cream beige (#F5F5DC), fine merino cashmere.

This outfit honors your request for a restrained and classic look while keeping you warm against the -3°C snow in the city center. The tailored blazer and wool trousers provide essential warmth without sacrificing style, creating a sophisticated silhouette perfect for an evening walk with friends. Neutral tones like charcoal, ivory, and deep slate ensure the ensemble remains understated yet polished, while the cashmere scarf adds a necessary layer of texture and insulation. Completing the look with classic leather loafers keeps the aesthetic timeless and comfortable for walking on potentially icy streets."}
